activity.notes: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte was appointed Marshal of France in 1804 and remained a major Napoleonic military figure before his election as successor to the Swedish throne in 1810. ATLAS ends this representative French-imperial military segment in 1810 rather than extending it into his Swedish political career.
